BrochureContent.Content:
O`Hanlon Property are pleased to present this attractive three bedroom semi-detached residence, ideally situated in a prime residential location just 1km from Carrickmacross town centre. This well maintained home offers spacious and bright accommodation throughout, making it an ideal choice for families, first-time buyers, or investors.

The property comprises a welcoming living room, a practical kitchen, three generously sized bedrooms, and a family bathroom. Outside, the home benefits from a large private rear garden and ample car parking. 

Location 


Carrickmacross is a well recognised market town serving a wide rural hinterland and with an excellent range of services on offer. There are three secondary and three primary schools in the town and there is a wide variety of leisure facilities including two Golf Courses, Football, Soccer, Athletics and Cycling Clubs and Dun a Rí Forest Park is 10 minutes` drive.

The town is highly regarded as a retail mecca for the region with an excellent variety of shops including Supervalu, Aldi and Lidl and there is a weekly street market. Leading international companies Active8 and Pilgrim`s Pride are amongst the main employers in the town. There are up to 20 bus connections to/from Dublin each day and Dundalk Train Station is within 25 minutes` drive.
